name: frame-moved-between-segments
description: Three valid frames from a segment with device_counter 42, placed under a header with device_counter 43 (everything else identical, header CRC valid).
asserts: Structurally clean (EOF, three frames): the CRCs and the chain are untouched. Keyed: AUTH_FAILED at frame 0. Both headers derive the same segment key, so the rejection comes from the AAD alone: every frame authenticates the segment header, so frames cannot be replayed into another bundle, vehicle, device or counter.
